additional_info.subject: RE: 0467714 - ID0467714-DC/Si-D/DK-[MP / R3 170001640] QA21-21 contactor error CRM:00472000484
additional_info.body:
Hello Rasmus,
The contactors coils are activated via state monitor.
From the experience we know that the failure during cable check is caused by defective state monitor. (KF13/KF14).
Also validate that plug XD10.1 doesn't have any false contact that can cut the 24V to the contactors.
I will move this case to your queue.
